Class ResourceBundleELResolver

java.lang.Object
jakarta.el.ELResolver
jakarta.el.ResourceBundleELResolver
public class ResourceBundleELResolver extends ELResolver
EL resolver for resource bundle properties.

This resolver handles base objects of type ResourceBundle. It accepts any non-null object as a property, coerces it to a String, and uses it to look up the corresponding message in the resource bundle. If the key is not found, the resolver returns a placeholder string of the form ???key???. Resource bundles are always read-only.

ELResolvers are combined using CompositeELResolvers to define rich semantics for evaluating an expression. See the javadocs for ELResolver for details.

Since:
EL 2.1
